description: Port Industry Growth is a dataset listed in Pierce County open data portal (internal.open.piercecountywa.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Pierce County. Track the percent change in total tons of cargo shipped through the Port of Tacoma each year. Coverage: Pierce County, Washington. The portal files it under the category Business. Its tags are industry, growth, port. The table has 6 columns. Attribution on the portal: Public records from Port of Tacoma. The portal shows 2022-06-03 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-internal-open-piercecountywa-gov-portal.
